meta.name: iteration-complete
meta.description: Run the quality gate after completing an iteration — review, fix, test, report, auto-commit. No principal approval needed (iteration boundary is auto-approved). Auto-emits a structured dispatch to captain so the small-batch-cadence daemon can pick up for PR landing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成迭代后自动执行质量门，审查并测试代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次迭代结束都需要走一遍质量检查流程
copy.tagline_en: Run quality gate after completing an iteration: review, fix, test, report, and auto-commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate the quality assurance process at the end of each development iteration

howto.what: 每次迭代完成后，Claude 自动运行质量门（审查、修复、测试、报告），然后自动提交代码，更新计划文件和交接文档，并向 captain 发送通知。
howto.when: 在一个阶段内完成一次迭代后，使用命令 /iteration-complete 加上迭代标识和描述触发。该技能只在工作树分支且存在未提交变更时可用。

say.text: 完成迭代 1.2：解析器边界情况
say.note: Claude 将执行质量门并自动提交。

say.text: 完成迭代 1.3：错误处理 --base abc1234
say.note: 使用指定基线执行质量门。

say.text: 迭代 2.1 已完成，请执行迭代完成流程
say.note: 无参数时 Claude 会先询问具体内容。

howto.what_en: After each iteration, Claude automatically runs the quality gate (review, fix, test, report), auto-commits, updates plan and handoff files, and dispatches a notification to captain.
howto.when_en: Triggered after completing an iteration within a phase by using the command /iteration-complete with iteration slug and description. Works only on worktree branches with uncommitted changes.

say_en.note: Claude will run quality gate and auto-commit.
Use specified baseline for quality gate.
If no arguments, Claude asks what was completed.
